broad_type.instructions: Choose the broad cell category best supported by the marker genes. Use tissue context when available. Select one option.

criteria.Immune cell: Cells of the hematopoietic immune system.
criteria.Endothelial cell: Cells lining blood or lymphatic vessels.
criteria.Epithelial cell: Epithelial cells forming tissue surfaces or glands.
criteria.Muscle cell: Contractile skeletal, cardiac, or smooth muscle cells.
criteria.Neural cell: Neurons and glial cells of the nervous system.
criteria.Unknown / other broad type: Use when none of the listed options is adequately supported by the marker genes.

cell_type.instructions: Choose the specific cell type best supported by the marker genes. Use tissue context when available. Select one option.

criteria.T cell: T lymphocyte, including conventional CD4 or CD8 T cells.
criteria.Fibroblast: Matrix-producing fibroblast or fibroblast-like stromal cell.
criteria.Epithelial cell: General epithelial cell when a more specific subtype is not justified.
criteria.Unknown / other cell type: Use when none of the listed options is adequately supported by the marker genes.

identity_coherence.instructions: How strongly do the marker genes support one clear, coherent cell identity?
criteria: No reliable single cell identity is supported: the markers are insufficient, nonspecific, or strongly conflicting across distinct cell identities.
Weak coherence: substantial conflicting or mixed cell-type evidence prevents a clear single-cell identity.
Ambiguous: one or more plausible cell identities are supported, with meaningful conflicting or mixed evidence.
Mostly coherent: one cell identity is clearly favored, with only minor conflicting or nonspecific evidence.
Highly coherent: the markers strongly and consistently support one clear cell identity.
